hook.text: A signal arrives smeared and distorted after bouncing through cables and air. Equalization reverses the damage.

buildup.text: Channels distort signals: some frequencies get amplified, others attenuated. The signal shape changes.

discovery.text: An equalizer applies the inverse of the channel's distortion, restoring the original signal shape.

twist.text: The channel changes over time. Adaptive equalizers continuously adjust their correction using training sequences.

climax.text: Without equalization, high-speed internet over copper or wireless would be impossible. It's silent and essential.

punchline.text: The channel distorts. The equalizer undoes it. Quietly.

quiz.question: What does an equalizer do in communication?
options: Reverses channel distortion to restore the signal
